title: “Call me sexist, but...”: Revisiting Sexism Detection Using Psychological Scales and Adversarial Samples

bias_targets.methodology: Developing a codebook based on psychological scales of sexism to annotate social media datasets, generating counterfactual adversarial examples through minimal text edits via crowdsourcing, and evaluating the classification performance and robustness of machine learning models (Logit, CNN, BERT) against these datasets.
